items.title: MECH-055 affective channel separation: narrowed two-axis-plus-harm-only representational diagnostic under world_rule_shift decoupling (diagnostic)
items.note: MECH-055 affective channel separation: the NARROWED two-axis-plus-harm-only REPRESENTATIONAL diagnostic that MECH-055's own what_would_answer (claims.yaml 2026-08-08) says CAN run now, given MECH-054's finding that only the HARM side of axis 3 is real (no benefit-side forward model or precision tracker anywhere in ree_core). DIAGNOSTIC -- excluded from confidence scoring; a clean pass records evidence_direction 'mixed', NOT 'supports', because the benefit-side channel does not exist to be verdicted. SCOPE: tests the claim's two FALSIFIERS at the representational level -- (ii) VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE and the harm-side forward-model PE numerically redundant -> C1; (i) two axes in a fixed predictable ratio -> C2; plus the second confirming clause (different variance/timing signatures) -> C3, C4. OUT OF SCOPE and stated so no reader over-reads a PASS: the benefit-side signed-PE channel, and the claim's first confirming clause in its BEHAVIOURAL form (V3-EXQ-799 found no downstream DV with enough sensitivity -- the write_gate breadth gap, routed to /implement-substrate and not landed). MANIPULATION: world_rule_shift (SD-MEL-PRODUCER), ARM_0_STATIONARY (off) vs ARM_2_HIGH_SHIFT (interval 10, depth 2) x seeds [42,137,2026] = 6 cells. Three other decoupling levers were checked against the substrate and REJECTED FIRST, each for a measured reason: SD-021/AIC descending attenuation (gated on the commitment latch via mode_weight, aic_analog.py:249, so it cannot fire commitment-free); harm_nonredundancy_weight (a FLOOR -- V3-EXQ-323 measured baseline cosine_sq at 8.5e-05..0.025, no headroom, and it is a dataclass field with no from_dims kwarg so from_dims silently swallows it); env_drift_interval (a measured NULL -- V3-EXQ-677's 999->3 manipulation gave a high-vs-low mean-PE difference of 8.8e-07 against a 0.01 threshold). env_drift is PINNED OFF in every arm so the rule-shift ladder is the only world-nonstationarity that varies. A third intermediate rung (interval 25) was designed and DROPPED on measured cost (~0.84 s CPU per env step on this config, 32 candidates re-proposed on ~99% of steps), not on doubt: no criterion consumes a middle rung. THE ACCUMULATION TRAP, and why it decides the readout: ResidueField.update_valence ADDS rather than replaces (residue/field.py:294), so the residue-field reads are monotone RAMPS (Step 2.5a probe measured VALENCE_HARM_DISCRIMINATIVE going 0 -> 460.4 over 592 fresh ticks). Correlating a ramp against a fluctuating forward-model residual would make C1 and C4 pass for reasons with NOTHING to do with channel separation -- a vacuous pass invisible in the manifest. So every criterion routes on per-tick INCREMENTS; the LEVELS are still recorded, including abs_spearman_valence_harm_LEVEL_vs_dacc_pe_unrouted (C1's own statistic computed the WRONG way) so a reader can SEE the size of the artifact the differencing removes. THRESHOLDS, all pre-registered constants: RHO_MAX 0.90 (TRANSCRIBED from SD-014's own channel-redundancy bar in V3-EXQ-887/887a/887b, not invented here), R2_MAX 0.80, REL_CHANGE_DELTA_MIN 0.20, LAG1_DELTA_MIN 0.10, SEED_QUORUM 2. READINESS FLOORS are substrate-not-ready, NOT claim verdicts: FORWARD_R2_MIN 0.30 (below it the dACC 'PE' degenerates to ||z_harm_a|| and axis 3 does not exist as a distinct channel), VH/TEMP/PE range floors, HARM_EXPOSURE_REL_DEV_MAX 0.25 (matched exposure is MEASURED, never assumed), PE_ELEVATION_MIN 0.05 scoped out of the stationary reference arm, FRESH_TICKS_MIN 200, CORR_MIN_N 100. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, fable, one pass): CONTESTED, 7 findings, 6 fixed in the driver and 1 already addressed. The three that changed what the run can conclude are all verified present in code: (a) the verdict-grid DECIDABILITY test runs BEFORE any claim verdict, so a shift arm going red on pe_load_elevated_vs_stationary while the stationary arm stayed green now routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue / non_contributory instead of being laundered into 'FALSIFIER (ii) FIRED' / weakens; (b) prev_action rewiring at both sites, so the harm forward model is trained on the SAME causal pairing the measured PE uses (sense() caches _harm_a_prev = z(t), select_action rolls e2_harm_a(z(t), a(t))); (c) episode-first-tick exclusion, because agent.reset() clears _harm_a_pred_prev so the first fresh tick of every episode reports a LEVEL not a residual -- excluded AND counted (n_level_pe_ticks_excluded), since a level is ~an order of magnitude above a residual and episode counts differ across arms. SAMPLE INTEGRITY: every per-tick read is gated on a FRESH E3 selection (FreshSelectProbe) -- E3 diagnostics latch between e3 ticks (default cadence 10), so an ungated per-env-step read would pseudo-replicate ~10x; n_latched_ticks is emitted. P2 is a FIXED 1800-STEP BUDGET, not an episode count, because episodes end early in the harsher shift arm and an episode-count loop would give the arms mechanically different series LENGTHS. DV-SYMMETRY: declared per arm in the driver -- every DV is a Spearman, an OLS R^2, a lag-1 autocorrelation or a relative change; the rule-shift re-permutation is neither an affine rescaling nor an added constant of any measured series, so no arm is disposition-(b) vacuous. C3 compares RELATIVE changes rather than raw magnitudes precisely because a broadcast additive constant would survive a magnitude readout (the V3-EXQ-604c false-positive shape), and C4 (lag-1) is the order-SENSITIVE companion to the tick-exchangeable pooled correlations. RECORDED, NON-GATING: cross_candidate_valence_range_post_action_mean with its shared-seed NEGATIVE CONTROL. PROVENANCE OF THIS QUEUEING: the driver was written by IGW-20260919-239, which died mid-smoke on 2026-09-19 leaving it UNTRACKED in the shared checkout. Its author wrote the _cross_candidate_valence_range helper, its consumer, its manifest prose and its run-level aggregation but never the two COLLECTION sites, so cc_post/cc_seed were read at row-build time and assigned nowhere -- a NameError that crashed the first re-smoke attempt on 2026-09-22 (correctly refusing to queue). validate_experiments --strict is AST-based and cannot see a dead variable read, which is why it passed 38/38 even with the bug. USER DECISION 2026-09-22: wire the two collection sites rather than drop the field, on the standing stance that telemetry is recorded generously rather than pruned. CADENCE, the one thing that could have been silently wrong: sampled inside the fresh-select guard, in the non-degenerate-PE branch, on exactly the ticks every other per-tick DV in the same row is sampled on -- determined by the driver's own recorded_non_gating_note, which states its Step 2.5a figure 'over 592 fresh ticks'. index=-1 is the post-action terminus, index=0 the rollout's shared initial z_world seed, per the helper's own docstring. HONEST LIMIT, measured up front by that same probe and REPRODUCED by this smoke: BOTH reads are exactly 0 on this substrate -- the candidates' rolled-out z_world lands far enough from every active RBF center that evaluate_valence returns ~0 for all of them (the collapsed-proposer regime V3-EXQ-614e measured at cand_world_pairwise_dist=0.0). So the negative control is UNINFORMATIVE, it cannot distinguish a correct statistic from a broken one, and NEITHER number may be cited as evidence about MECH-035 or about candidate diversity. MECH-035 is deliberately NOT tagged. Both are recorded only so a successor that fixes the proposer regime can see what this substrate did; neither gates, because MECH-055's collapse-risk check reads the REALIZED z_world, not the candidate pool. SMOKE 2026-09-22 (rc=0, --dry-run, 1 seed x BOTH arms, p2_budget 60): both arms ran through _run_cell to completion, cross-arm aggregation ran, and the verdict grid routed through its DECIDABILITY branch to outcome=FAIL label=substrate_not_ready_requeue direction=non_contributory -- the correct route at 60 fresh ticks against FRESH_TICKS_MIN 200 and a negative 4-episode forward r2, and it exercises the red-team fix (a) path. ARM_2_HIGH_SHIFT had never executed before this smoke. The newly wired fields populated finite on all 4 cell reads (post_action 0.0, shared_seed 0.0, n_fresh_select 60, n_level_pe_ticks_excluded 1, n_series 58 per cell), matching the author's own probe exactly. SLEEP DRIVER: none. PCC weights re-scoped as V3-EXQ-799 did (fatigue 0.15 / offline 0.35 / window 200) because 799 measured the substrate DEFAULTS pin mu at ~0.017 against a [0,1] clip, a structurally unsatisfiable readout; the acceptance thresholds are NOT relaxed to compensate. PROMOTES NOTHING on its own: diagnostic, and the benefit-side gap keeps MECH-055 from a 'supports' read regardless of outcome.
items.machine_affinity_note: 'any' deliberately, NOT a pin: the Mac runner is deliberately off, so 'any' routes to the cloud workers and lets the scaler power on 2/3/4 for queue demand. Pinning a worker would opt out of that scaling for no gain -- nothing here is machine-class-bound (no arm fingerprint is minted or consumed) and the run is far too heavy for the laptop at ~0.84 s CPU per env step.

items.title: MECH-266/SD-032a: squash-vs-clamp affinity bounding-operator cap sweep with gain-matched control arm (diagnostic)
items.note: Validates mode-governance-engagement ITEM (1) (the affinity bounding operator) ONLY; items (2) commitment-term grading and (3) production default remain OPEN and are untouched. DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). PROMOTES NOTHING -- MECH-266 / SD-032a pending_retest_after_substrate holds, and the Stage-H nav-competence dependency gating v3_exq_464d/467d is untouched. DESIGN: crosses the affinity bounding OPERATOR with the cap at EVAL time on clones of one trained curriculum agent per seed (cap, mode and sigma all read live at SalienceCoordinator.tick()). THREE bound arms x CAP_SWEEP [0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75] x 2 rail arms x 3 seeds [42,43,44] = 30 cells/seed: clamp_baseline (w=3.0, the V3-EXQ-934 baseline design), squash (sigma=cap default), and clamp_gain_matched (clamp operator, w'(cap)=3.0*(cap/(cap+1))/min(1,cap)) -- the ATTRIBUTION CONTROL added by USER DECISION 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z OPTION A. Training held at cap 2.0 under the clamp (464e/934 construction). Seeds 42-44 kept deliberately (934's; its seed 44 guard-PASSED with the highest contact rate, 0.3064). LOAD-BEARING DV: occupancy -- the squash arm's ARM_SYMMETRIC gate via experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py, GRADED iff >=2 CONSECUTIVE cap values each mixed in (0.1,0.9) on >=2/3 seeds. Bar TRANSCRIBED from the entry's own failure_record target, never re-derived; gate called ONCE per (bound_arm, rail_arm) over ALL (seed,cap) cells with seed AND sweep_value populated -- NOT 934's per-seed call shape, which is what produced its false routing. The continuous margin is RECORDED AS TELEMETRY WITH NO THRESHOLD (user decision): no numeric threshold for the squash-vs-clamp contrast is registered anywhere. WHY THE THIRD ARM: red-team pass 1 (fable) returned BLOCKING, verified against source -- the operator is applied to EVERY affinity_weights signal (salience_coordinator.py:616-636) including the [0,1]-bounded external_task_drive (agent.py:2760-2765, w=3.0), and at sigma=cap the squash returns 0.500x AT the cap, so clamp->squash moved the external_task logit by -0.96..-1.50 while the dacc_pe degeneracy fix under test moved its logit by only -0.034..-0.173 (8x-28x confound). With two arms neither a PASS nor the null was attributable. GFLAG-0370 records this and also that the why_sigma_equals_cap rationale in the substrate entry does not hold as written. RED-TEAM pass 1 (fable): BLOCKING -> resolved by user OPTION A. RED-TEAM pass 2 (fable, licensed re-spawn since the manipulation changed): CONTESTED, 4 findings, ALL reproduced against source and FIXED -- (F1) the (squash NOT graded, gain_matched graded) cell was unrouted and recorded a false 'no_arm_graded' reason with SD-032a weakens, now its own branch -> gain/non_contributory; (F2) the gain match holds only at engagement e=1.0, so 'the control did not grade' could be over-cutting rather than gradedness -- a false-positive path to supports; cells now record REALIZED drive contribution under all three arm definitions and the gradedness attribution is gated on gain_match_valid (residual < the gain cut it reproduces; boundary definitional, not tuned); (F3) 'occupancy static across arms' was attributed to the item-(2) latch unconditionally, now requires et_sat_mean>0 since engagement near zero produces the same reading; (F4) INHERITED FROM V3-EXQ-934 -- the external_task_drive_engages precondition cannot see a dead drive: measured, with the drive signal at EXACTLY 0.0 the margin still reads 0.3287-0.4950, 6.6x-9.9x the 0.05 floor, because it is floored by external_task_bias=1.0; added external_task_drive_signal_nonzero (a zero-test on the drive's own value). F4 is worth governance attention on its own account. PAIRING: cells are RNG- AND ENV-paired across bound arms (per-cell seed derives from (seed,cap,rail_arm) only, driving reset_all_rng and a fresh per-cell env), bound arm nested INNERMOST -- fixes the vacuous 1e-6 non-degeneracy guard (banked 934 cells differing only in rails already differed by 1.7e-3) and the shared-stateful-env order confound. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout = per-cap occupancy under salience_affinity_bound_mode='squash'; that mode landed 2026-09-19 and NO recorded manifest has ever set it (934/935/935a are all clamp-only), so the readout is absent from every banked run -> must run, not reanalyzable. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: MECH-266/SD-032a count=7 but RELEASED -- the named upstream substrate (mode-governance-engagement item (1), cingulate.salience_coordinator.affinity_bound_operator) shows IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-19 in ree-v3/CLAUDE.md; and this is a new EXQ number testing a different mechanism (the operator family) as a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which Step 2.5b exempts independently. STEP 2.5c: no open 'corrupting' substrate_queue entry overlaps this driver's modules (mode-governance-engagement itself is severity=cosmetic). Runs under these open 'degrading' entries, recorded as known limitations: SD-018 and SD-106 (agent.py::compute_resource_proximity_loss, latent/stack.py), sd061-resume-progress-ecology (causal_grid_world.py::CausalGridWorldV2.step), SD-091 (agent.py::REEAgent.select_action), SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (config.py, causal_grid_world.py, agent.py), SD-ZWORLD-SENSE-PATH-PARITY (agent.py::REEAgent.sense). SMOKE: PASS (rc=0) -- 12 cells (3 arms x 2 caps x 2 rails), denominator ep N/45, 1 verdict line, gain-matched weights exact (1.714286 at cap 0.75, 1.5 at cap 1.0); a guard-passing run exercised the full analysis path and landed on the new F3 branch (et_drive_mean=0.7256, et_sat=0.0 -> static_but_latch_not_implicated, non_contributory), which pre-fix would have recorded SD-032a weakens against a latch that never fired. validate_experiments --strict: 38/38 OK. Successor to V3-EXQ-934; NOT a supersede -- 934 measured the clamp across the same band and that reading stands.
